_readme: Copy this file to local.settings.json and fill in the values. local.settings.json is excluded from git.

Values._SmartTableSync:Mode_readme: Manual (default): scaffold the child DB by hand via SmartTableSync.Scaffold, then add tables to TableList once applied. Auto: the Function creates/updates child DDL itself on first sight of a table or parent schema drift - requires ChildProvisioningConnectionString below.
Values._ChildProvisioningConnectionString_readm: Only required when SmartTableSync:Mode is Auto. Uses the smarttablesync-child-provisioning identity (see sql/07_permissions.sql) - the same one SmartTableSync.Scaffold already uses, never the runtime identity above.
Values._SmartTableSync:ChangeTrackingColumns_re: Per-table override of the incremental change-tracking column name. A table not listed here defaults to 'LastUpdate'. Example: "SmartTableSync:ChangeTrackingColumns:SomeOtherTable": "ModifiedAt".
Values._SmartTableSync:AllowFullRescanFor_readm: Comma-separated table names explicitly allowed to fall back to a full-table re-scan every incremental cycle when their change-tracking column doesn't exist, even above PlanHeuristicOptions.FullRescanRowCountThreshold (50,000 rows by default). Small tables below that threshold fall back automatically without needing to be listed here.
